description: Convert one cooking amount between units: within volume or weight exactly, or between volume and weight using a built-in density for flour, sugar, brown sugar, butter, water, milk, rice, oats, cocoa or honey. Use for questions like 'how many grams is 2 cups of flour'. Do NOT use to change serving counts (use scale_recipe).

from.description: Unit to convert from, e.g. 'cup'. Supported: tsp, tbsp, cup, fl_oz, ml, l, pint, quart, gallon (volume); g, kg, oz, lb (weight); each (count). Common spellings like 'cups', 'grams', 'tablespoon' also work

ingredient.description: Ingredient name, required only for volume <-> weight; must contain one of flour, sugar, brown sugar, butter, water, milk, rice, oats, cocoa, honey (e.g. 'all-purpose flour')

to.description: Unit to convert to, e.g. 'g'; same supported units as from

value.description: Amount to convert, zero or positive, e.g. 2

name: convert_units

display.description: Readable conversion, e.g. '2 cups flour = 250 g (approx.)'

title: Convert units
